pylons_vi: 2 tháp chữ H: hai chân thẳng nghiêng vào từ bệ móng đến dầm ngang trên (≈½ chiều cao trên mặt cầu), phía trên là hai cột đứng neo dây; dầm ngang lớn dưới mặt cầu; cao 123,5 m từ đỉnh bệ, 84,43 m trên mặt cầu (≈120 m trên mực nước cao)
pylons_en: 2 H pylons: straight legs leaning inward from the pile cap to one upper crossbeam (≈half the above-deck height), then two vertical posts carrying the stays; deep under-deck crossbeam; 123.5 m above the pile cap, 84.43 m above the deck (≈120 m above high water)

pylon_custom.description: H pylon (Mỹ Thuận): two straight legs lean inward (≈6° from vertical) all the way from a long stadium pile cap, past the deck, to a single upper crossbeam with a gently arched soffit at ≈0.5 of the above-deck height; above it the legs continue as two near-vertical posts ≈19 m apart with chamfered tops, carrying the stay anchorages. A deep under-deck crossbeam with a haunched soffit carries the girder between the legs. Stays in two near-vertical planes 18.6 m apart, semi-fan.

model3d.notes: r10: Spans 150 + 350 + 150 (TEDI), no auxiliary piers; anchor piers at the unit ends, outer stays land 5 m beyond them. H pylons 123.5 m above the pile-cap top and 84.43 m above the deck (TEDI); ≈120 m above high water (press). Drawn: deck 30 m at the unit ends, 37.5 m at the pylons, 40.5 m at mid-span (clearance 37.5 × 110 m), tip ≈121 m above the water. Legs lean inward from the cap to one upper beam at ≈0.5 of the above-deck height, then vertical posts; deep under-deck beam. 128 stays = 16 per side per plane, semi-fan, two planes 18.6 m apart (drawn at the deck edges), blue HDPE sheaths. Concrete girder: two 1.76 m edge girders, 23.66 m deck. Leg and beam geometry measured on Commons photos.
